programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The police investigate when a severed leg is discovered among garbage. Conventional means of identifying the victim are impossible, leading investigators to rely on DNA, forensic anthropology and toxicology.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A coroner finds telltale clues on the badly burned body of a murder victim, sending police in pursuit of a couple of killers.

programme.desc: Soon after becoming pregnant by Dr. Maynard Muntzing, firefighter Michelle Baker's health quickly deteriorates. Eventually, she raises suspicions that Muntzing is doing her harm.

programme.desc: While investigating an apparent overdose suicide, detectives recover incriminating files from a computer.

programme.desc: The murders of an elderly couple leave police stumped until, two years later, they receive a major break.

programme.desc: Discovering that an assault suspect is left-handed is crucial to a police investigation dating back 16 years.

programme.desc: Authorities track a kidnapper who let his victim write a last will and informed the family of her murder.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying like a teardrop in the Indian Ocean, Sri Lanka is an island that defies convention. Poised just six degrees above the equator, it's less than 75,000 km sq in size. But it has enough wildlife to rival a continent, and it's all down to its complicated climate and geography.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: In Anchorage, one bird rules the roost...the Bald Eagle. Expert hunters, they are perfectly adapted to life in tough arctic conditions, but in Anchorage, the secret to their survival... is trash. Every day, hundreds of bald eagles gather at the city dump, dodging trucks, machinery, and even pyrotechnics, in search of an easy meal. But this city life also brings constant danger, for the eagles themselves, and also for the human residents.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: One of Alaska's most secretive and efficient predators, Lynx are usually highly elusive... but in Anchorage, houses are being built in the Lynx's territory, forcing these usually shy big cats, to find new ways to survive on the streets. As this urban jungle continues to expand into the wilderness, encounters between people and wild Lynx are on the rise. In this wild city, can people live side by side with Alaska's deadliest big cat?

programme.title: Migrations - Frequent Flyers
programme.desc: Migration is one of the most remarkable phenomena of the natural world, and perhaps the most impressive migrants of all travel on the wing.

programme.title: Owls - Masters of the Night
programme.desc: Owls are mysterious creatures, living in a twilight world that we can rarely visit. Many cultures, including the Romans, Mayans and Aztecs, saw owls as something to fear, symbols of bad luck and impending doom. In reality owls are highly resourceful birds that have carved out a niche and a unique way to live. They range in size from smaller than a pigeon to as large as an eagle. They've colonised terrains from tundra to rainforest.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: Turkey sits on a jumbled collection of tectonic plates, whose collisions have created a tortuous landscape. In fact 80% of Turkeys terrain is rough, broken and mountainous. Mountain ranges both collect and block weather systems, affecting the climate across the country and producing huge contrasts between and within differing habitats.

programme.title: Wild Uruguay
programme.desc: Uruguay's biodiversity is surprisingly greater than one would expect. We will find out why as we embark on a journey through its ecosystems and landscapes to discover its fauna. Today we know that Uruguay is more than just the outermost edge of the Pampas, as the country holds a range of ecosystems. Within its borders, species of the Pampas come face to face with species of the Atlantic Forest, the Misiones rainforest, and the Chaco forest, giving rise to unexpected encounters.

programme.title: The Enchanted Forest
programme.desc: To spend a day in the forest, from dawn to dusk, is to bathe in nature. There's enchantment at every turn. Throughout the day the cast of characters in the forest changes, from foraging bears to playing fox cubs, dashing hummingbirds and dancing butterflies. But it's as twilight descends, that the most enchanting side of the forest is revealed. Time to watch a firework display curtesy of fireflies. They are the real magicians of the enchanted forest.

programme.title: Cost of Progress
programme.desc: The natural world is in crisis. For years humanity has exploited the planet's resources, and the creatures that live here. Growth and innovation can be a marvelous thing, but at what cost to our one and only planet? When we continue to push ahead blindly, it's more often than not Mother Nature that pays the price. Now it is time for us to rally - to take heed and start to turn back the tide. It's time for us to recognize our part in this crisis and redress the balance of the cost of progress.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Over the last million years, our planet suffered a series of major ice-ages. Much of the northern hemisphere was covered in ice sheets several kilometres thick and creatures had no choice but to adapt or die. Over time, temperatures rose, causing these glaciers to retreat, however, in certain parts of Europe the ice-age never left. For many creatures, the struggle to survive 'a life below zero' continues.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: This city spends most of the year encased in ice...but when summer hits, Anchorage bursts into life. Animals and plants living this far north have been forced to adapt, working faster to make the most of the short season, but these animals built to withstand Alaska's extreme winters, often struggle in Anchorage's summer heat! Temperatures can be surprisingly high, with average July highs of 26 degrees C. 300,000 people live alongside these wild animals in the ever growing city of Anchorage.

programme.title: Creepy Crawlies - Army
programme.desc: Few creatures have the complex levels of regimented society as the social insects; these creatures understand that the strength of the individual is nothing compared with the combined power of the group. Creepy crawlies can form armies to help them build elaborate homes, raise their young and hunt their prey. These incredible communities both plagues our nightmares and fuels our imaginations. Society is considered the realm of higher beings, but hidden amongst the foliage, an army is rising.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Grizzly Bears, Orcas, Elephants, Wolves, Olive Baboons In many human cultures, elders play a vital role in the well-being of communities and are responsible for passing down knowledge and culture. Is it any wonder to find that the orca, the elephant, and the wolf, have been found to transmit their respective cultures to the younger generations? Young animals learn by observing their elders.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: The top of New Zealand's South Island is a landscape of two halves. To the West, one of the longest natural sandbars on the planet curves protectively around Golden Bay. To the East, mountains sink into the sea, their drowned river valleys forming the Marlborough Sounds. Turbulent currents connect them, both treacherous and full of riches.
programme.sub-title: Top of the South/ Te Tau Ihu

programme.title: Urban Warrirors
programme.desc: As human populations grow, so does our footprint, and more of the natural world is gradually paved over, displacing animals from their natural homes. It presents a staggering number of difficulties for those creatures that find themselves cut off from their natural habitat, but there is a growing band of urban warriors stepping up to the challenge. City life for some means living on the breadline, while others discover a land of opportunity - a new concrete frontier.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: On the doorstep of one of the country's biggest cities, Muaūpoko /Otago Peninsula provides a breeding refuge for birds and marine mammals. Northern royal albatrosses return here every year to raise their chicks at the world's only mainland colony. On sheltered beaches around the Peninsula, once hunted from these shores, New Zealand sea lions are returning to form a breeding colony after an absence of centuries.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Deserts - dry, arid landscapes, environments of intense sun, heat and very little rain. The desert is extreme. An extre-me climate and an extreme environment where wild life has had to adapt to survive. Many of the animals that live in deserts have adopted a nocturnal lifestyle, surfacing only at night when it is cooler.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: The masters of the sky are the winged predators of the aerial world. Whether swooping from altitude at phenomenal speed to strike an unsuspecting target from above, flicking and darting between trees in a lethal tail chase, or ghos-ting silently through the night in pursuit of prey, they excite our admiration and inspire awe in equal measure. All are superbly adapted to hunting and masters of their position at the top of the food chain.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Lakes and rivers are created by streams high in the mountains. Fresh water springs, rain drawn up as moisture from the oceans, and melting snow all ebb, rush and flow down into our rivers and streams. Streams, rivers and lakes are home to countless animal species. A wide variety of species from insects, to amphibians, repti-les, fish, birds and even mammals are found in rivers, lakes and streams all around the world.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Wildlife that inhabits mountainous regions has be able to survive successfully at high altitudes. Any creature that lives in the mountains must also be able to cope with changing temperatures. Many species of hoofed and herbivorous mammal such as GOATS, DEER, SHEEP AND LLAMAS have adapted well to living high in the mountains and are often found grazing on ledges and on cliff faces. These herbivores in turn attract large predators such as BEARS, COUGARS AND MOUNTAIN LIONS.

programme.title: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Being a wild mum is one of the toughest jobs on earth. From the second a mother gives birth, everything changes. No longer footloose and fancy free, they find themselves completely responsible for tiny, delicate little lives - lives that would be helpless without them. For some, being a mother comes naturally, whilst for others it will take a little practoce. But while the responsibility is immense, being a mum is also incredible.

programme.title: Easter The Start of Something Big
programme.desc: Easter, not just a chocolate feast loved by children. One of the biggest events in the religious calendar, celebrated by millions and steeped in customs and traditions. And for all its different meanings there are some key characters we associate with the holiday: chicks, bunnies and lambs have become integral to our celebrations. How have these animals become a part of Easter tradition? There are many twists and turns in the story, but without a doubt this is the start of something big!

programme.title: Secret Life of Baby Owls
programme.desc: Owls - with their huge eyes, flat faces and distinctive hoot - they are truly iconic!creatures. But how much do we really know about these mysterious nocturnal birds? We're about to find out as we follow the fate of new born baby owls as they grow up and learn to fly.

programme.title: Hidden Spain
programme.desc: Spain is found at the crossroads between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic, resulting in diverse landscapes, ancient cultures and magnificent wildlife.

programme.title: Hawaii: Paradise in the Pacific
programme.desc: In epsiode one we take a look at Kaua'i - the oldest island in the archipelago. Kaua'i's isolation for thousands of years led to an increased rate of evolution. In a relatively short time, new species are formed here, many animals and plants can only be found here. But they are in danger. On the shield volcano Waiʻaleʻale - the rainiest place on earth, scientists like Lukas Behnke are fighting for the preservation of endangered native animals and plants.

programme.title: Hunters of the Forest
programme.desc: Forests are dark, shady habitats, realms of shadows perfect for predators to lurk. The dense plant growth facilitates a wealth of prey species, and cunning predators of all shapes and sizes have adapted to exploit every niche. Whether crawling on the forest floor, gliding through the trees or stalking the shadows in between, hunters have mastered the terrain in every type of forest imagina-ble.

programme.title: June (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: It's chaos in the Northern hemisphere, our bird feeders are busy as parents work around the clock to raise their young. There's a baby boom, and young foxes, even in our city centres, leave their dens to explore. Its winter in the south though, cold times for guanacos on the slopes of the Andes. And dry times for elephants in Botswana. They migrate north to the life-giving waters of the Chobe River

programme.title: Nature's Oddballs - Creatures of the Night
programme.desc: hile we sleep comfortably in our beds, one of the most spectacular groups of animals go to work - prepare to meet the creatures of the night!

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Te Moananui a Toi/ The Hauraki Gulf lies on the doorstep of New Zealand's largest city. Every summer millions of visitors from the tropics converge here, all lured by a unique seasonal smorgasbord. Giant oceanic manta rays, rarely filmed in these waters, glide into the gulf. Bryde's whales are also primed for the feasting season, alongside common dolphins, and bronze whaler sharks. In the sky above rare black petrels stalk the dolphins to survive.
programme.sub-title: Te Moananui a Toi/ The Hauraki Gulf

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: On the coast of south Africa, a group of mammoth mammals is arriving from the deep ocean. Every year humpback and southern right whales make incredible migrations from the Antarctic seas to mate and give birth along southern Africa's rich protected coast. Just arriving in time won't be enough to guarantee a mate. Humpbacks conduct awe-inspiring aerial displays and chaotic competitions for attention before showing off their grace in underwater ballets.

programme.title: Magical Fjords
programme.desc: Fjords are one of the most dramatic landscapes on Earth, but their majesty is just the tip of the iceberg. Fjords stand witness to some of the greatest wonders of the animal kingdom. Fjords are found in a frozen land where only the toughest survive. Whether just below the surface, at the murky depths of the sea floor or on dry land, the fjords offer an incredible bounty to wildlife.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: As soon as she arrives, conservationist Hannah Emde immerses herself in Namibia's wildlife. The first destination of her trip is the world-famous Naankuse Foundation near Windhoek. In addition to a veterinary clinic, the sanctuary includes 85,000 hectares of wilderness, where endangered and rescued animals live.

programme.title: Fighting for a Mate
programme.desc: Animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each animal fights with a unique set of tools, from display structures and elaborate body language to claws, jaws and antlers. And few fights are as fuelled as those during breeding season; the ultimate trophy for the brave fighter is, of course, a chance to pass on the fighting genes to the next generation.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: When Spring comes one animal arrives in its thousands. It's the salmon. Travelling an incredible 3500 miles through rivers and streams they are Alaska's hardiest resident. Using their muscular bodies they can swim up stream jumping over any obstacle that comes in their way. But there is one grizzly hazard they face right at the end of their journey. It's the brown bears. These expert fishermen use skill and accuracy to grab onto the salmon with their powerful teeth.

programme.title: Deserts
programme.desc: All habitats present difficulties, but the challenges of the desert are more obvious than most - scorching heat and a lack food and water make them one of the most hostile environments on the planet. But with great challenges come incredible solutions. Despite the deadly conditions, a hardy band of unique animal and plant species have adapted to meet the inhospitable desert conditions head on.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: The poaching of rhinos for their horn has brought these animals to the brink of extinction. Namibia's black rhinos are hard to find. The Save The Rhino Trust has been fighting for the protection of the pachyderms every day for 30 years under the most adverse conditions. Hannah Emde accompanies the anti-poaching unit through the semi-desert for a day. She learns how difficult it is to track the animals and can hardly believe her luck when she finds a mother with her calf.

programme.title: January (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: In Europe in January, we sit around in the dark, missing the bright lights and festivities of Christmas, perhaps it would cheer us up to imagine January around the world. To the north, polar bear cubs are born and nestle against their hibernating mothers, but on the other side of the planet, kangaroos are experiencing the highest temperatures and having to trek in search of water, while in East Africa, wildebeest arrive on their breeding grounds and enjoy a baby-boom on a giant scale.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying 40km off the east coast of Tanzania in Africa, the Zanzibar Archipelago has been labelled the most exotic island chain in the world. Pristine sands and azure blue sea make it a much loved holiday destination, but bizarre creatures, many of enormous size, also roam the islands. The world's largest crab scales trees in search of coconuts, and clouds of giant bats fill the skies at dusk.

programme.title: Meet the Mustelids
programme.desc: To many ears the name mustelid might sound mysterious and confusing. They may sound strange, but this family of hunters are probably much more familiar than you think. They're tiny terrors; ankle-height tigers of the undergrowth. From the icy northern climbs where the bold wolverine quietly rules the forests, scattering wolves with a fearsome glance, to the sun-drenched wetlands of the Amazon where man-sized giant otters work together to protect their families and defend their homes.

programme.title: From Prada to Nada
programme.desc: Spoiled sisters Nora (Camilla Belle) and Mary (Alexa Vega) Dominguez have a life of wealth and privilege in Beverly Hills. However, their world crashes when their father dies suddenly. Now penniless, the two have to move in with their Aunt Aurelia (Adriana Barraza) in East L.A.'s Boyle Heights. Striving to work through the culture clash, Nora and Mary begin to embrace their Latin heritage, discover romance, and learn the meaning of family.

programme.title: Lars and the Real Girl
programme.desc: Extremely shy Lars (Ryan Gosling) finds it impossible to make friends or socialize. His brother (Paul Schneider) and sister-in-law (Emily Mortimer) worry about him, so when he announces that he has a girlfriend he met on the Internet, they are overjoyed. But Lars' new lady is a life-size plastic woman. On the advice of a doctor (Patricia Clarkson), his family and the rest of the community go along with his delusion.

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

programme.title: Cadillac Man
programme.desc: Car dealer Joey O'Brien (Robin Williams) is spread as thin financially as he is in his love life. He's dating more women than he can remember, and the local toughs he's borrowed money from want it back. In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage.

programme.title: Cruel Intentions
programme.desc: Annette (Reese Witherspoon) unwittingly becomes a pawn in Sebastian's (Ryan Phillippe) and Kathryn's (Sarah Michelle Gellar) deliciously diabolical wager of sexual conquest when she writes an article in Seventeen Magazine about how she intends to stay pure until she marries her boyfriend. However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist.

programme.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
programme.desc: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down.

programme.title: Repo! The Genetic Opera
programme.desc: In the mid-21st century, an epidemic of organ failures leads to the rise of GeneCo., a company providing transplants at a great price. Those who miss their payments become targets of GeneCo. Mercenaries, who repossess the organs. In a world of drug addiction and legalized murder, a sheltered youth seeks a cure for her rare disease as well as information about her family's mysterious history. Her questions are answered at "The Genetic Opera."

programme.title: She's Back
programme.desc: Killed by local punks, a man's (Robert Joy) wife (Carrie Fisher) comes back to lead him and a landfill operator (Matthew Cowles) in revenge.

programme.title: You Hurt My Feelings
programme.desc: A novelist's long-standing marriage is suddenly upended when she overhears her husband give his honest reaction to her latest book.

programme.title: Laggies
programme.desc: When 28-year-old Megan attends her 10-year high-school reunion, she realizes that very little in her life has changed. An unexpected marriage proposal from her boyfriend sparks panic in Megan, causing her to wander off into the night. She meets 16-year-old Annika and proceeds to get drunk. Deciding she needs a break from her unfulfilling life, she tells her boyfriend she's going to a seminar but hangs with Annika.

programme.title: The Disaster Artist
programme.desc: The incredible true story of aspiring filmmaker and Hollywood outsider Tommy Wiseau as he and his best friend defiantly pursue their dreams and embark on the hilarious odyssey of making the now-infamous, cult classic "The Room."

programme.title: Jackie's Back!
programme.desc: A British documentarian (Tim Curry) profiles a washed-up diva (Jenifer Lewis) as she prepares for her comeback concert.

programme.title: Coming Soon
programme.desc: Privileged teenage friends Jenny (Gaby Hoffmann), Nell (Tricia Vessey) and Stream (Bonnie Root) spend their senior year on a quest to rid Stream of her virginity. However, Stream wants more than just her first sexual experience. She wants to have an orgasm -- but achieving this proves problematic, as the boys she meets are hardly sensitive enough to provide her the release she seeks. When it becomes clear that Nell and Jenny have never experienced an orgasm either, all three set out to get one.

programme.title: She's Back
programme.desc: Killed by local punks, a man's (Robert Joy) wife (Carrie Fisher) comes back to lead him and a landfill operator (Matthew Cowles) in revenge.

programme.title: Elvira's Haunted Hills
programme.desc: In the 19th century, a buxom woman (Cassandra Peterson) of mystery and shtick visits a castle inhabited by a fatally cursed family.

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: Housewife and mother Ruth Patchett (Roseanne Barr), an overweight and unkempt woman, can seem to do nothing to make her husband, Bob (Ed Begley Jr.), happy. When he becomes embroiled in an affair with romance novelist Mary Fisher (Meryl Streep), Patchett does all she can to ignore it until Bob finally leaves her for Fisher. Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist.

programme.title: The Lazarus Effect
programme.desc: Medical researcher Frank (Mark Duplass), his fiancée Zoe (Olivia Wilde) and their team have achieved the impossible: they have found a way to revive the dead. After a successful, but unsanctioned, experiment on a lifeless animal, they are ready to make their work public. However, when their dean learns what they've done, he shuts them down. Zoe is killed during an attempt to recreate the experiment, leading Frank to test the process on her. Zoe is revived -- but something evil is within her.

programme.title: Masters of the Universe
programme.desc: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. However, courageous warrior He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) locates inventor Gwildor (Billy Barty), who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon.

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
programme.desc: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend's salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Crooks (Jackie Chan, Louis Koo) grow attached to the baby they kidnapped.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven 2
programme.desc: In this animated film, Charlie Barkin (Charlie Sheen) is finding life in dog heaven a little dull. Even after his best pal, Itchy (Dom DeLuise), arrives in town, Charlie still longs to go back to Earth. When Charlie's old nemesis, Carface (Ernest Borgnine), steals the horn used by the archangel Gabriel, Charlie and Itchy quickly volunteer to retrieve it. Back on the planet, while scrambling to outwit Carface and get the horn, Charlie meets an alluring pooch named Anabelle (Bebe Neuwirth).

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: Mark (John Larroquette) and Jessie (Kirstie Alley) get blindsided by an unexpected visit from Mark's cousin, Fred (John Diehl), and his pregnant wife, Bernice (Jessica Lundy). The family reunion is suddenly extended from five days to six months after an accident renders Bernice bedridden, and Mark and Jessie's life is slowly turned upside down by a seemingly never-ending stream of house guests, including Jessie's neurotic sister (Alison La Placa) and her obnoxious son (Bradley Gregg).

programme.title: Spare Parts
programme.desc: With the help of their high school's newest teacher (George Lopez), four Hispanic students form a robotics club. Although they have no experience, the youths set their sights on a national robotics contest. With $800 and parts scavenged from old cars, they build a robot and compete against reigning champion MIT. Along the way, the students learn not only how to build a robot but something far more important: how to forge bonds that will last a lifetime.

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: Zack (Dane Cook) and Vince (Dax Shepard) are rival co-workers at Super Club, the country's largest bulk-discount retailer, but while Vince is on the fast track at Super Club, Zack's laid-back approach to work holds him back. That all changes when a new cashier, named Amy (Jessica Simpson), transfers to their store. Zack is instantly smitten, but Amy prefers Vince. Zack determines that the only way to win her is to win his store's most coveted honor.

programme.desc: Christmas is anything but ordinary when bickering siblings in a newly blended household magically switch bodies.

programme.title: Sprung
programme.desc: Clyde (Joe Torry) and his photographer pal Montel (Rusty Cundieff) meet gold digger Adina (Paula Jai Parker) and her friend Brandy (Tisha Campbell), a law student, at a party. While Clyde convinces Adina that he's wealthy, Montel and Brandy pair off and get along well. Adina is furious when she learns Clyde has misled her, but when they learn their friends plan to marry -- which would force the two enemies to spend time together -- they put their differences aside to thwart the marriage.

programme.title: Night Train
programme.desc: Greed and betrayal ensnares three people (Danny Glover, Steve Zahn, Leelee Sobieski) when they find a stash of diamonds aboard a train.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Outlaw Johnny Black
programme.desc: Cowboy Johnny Black vows to gun down Brett Clayton, the man responsible for the death of his father. He soon becomes a wanted outlaw while posing as a preacher in a small mining town that's been taken over by a notorious land baron.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
programme.desc: Jimmie and his best friend Mont try to reclaim the house built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship and sense of belonging in the place they call home.

programme.title: Outlaw Johnny Black

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: During a routine prison work detail, convict Piper (Laurence Fishburne) is chained to Dodge (Stephen Baldwin), a cyberhacker, when gunfire breaks out. Apparently, the attack is related to stolen money that the Mafia is after, and some computer files that somebody wants desperately to bury. The pair, who don't exactly enjoy each other's company, escape and must work together if they are to reach Atlanta alive. Luckily, they meet a woman (Salma Hayek) who may be willing to help them.

programme.title: The Trap
programme.desc: A man returns home to Atlanta to save his family's struggling restaurant with the help of a new chicken recipe.

programme.title: Who's Your Caddy?
programme.desc: Superstar rap mogul C-Note (Antwan "Big Boi" Patton) wants to join the Carolina Pines Golf & Country Club, but faces stiff opposition from the establishment's snooty members. C-Note forces the issue by purchasing the land adjacent to the golf course's 17th hole. As the club leaders search for a way to revoke his membership, C-Note realizes his family's honor and golf history are at stake, and digs in for the fight of his life.

programme.title: Snipes
programme.desc: Erik Triggs is a good-natured Philadelphia teen and aspiring rapper who works at a hip-hop record label. There he hangs with rising superstar Prolifik during the day and works on his own music after hours. However, when Prolifik is kidnapped and his unreleased album is stolen, the record label's sleazy owner, Bobby Starr, assumes Erik and his friend Malik are responsible. The two soon find themselves on the run.

programme.title: The Son of No One
programme.desc: When he was a youth in the Queensborough projects, Jonathan White (Channing Tatum) -- then known as Milk -- killed a couple of junkies. His dead father's former partner, Detective Stanford (Al Pacino), got him off the hook for the crime. Now a rookie police officer himself, Jonathan remains haunted by the incident. When a Queens reporter (Juliette Binoche) receives anonymous tips regarding the long-ago crime, the implications for both White and Stanford are clear.

programme.desc: Four friends enter the drug trade in Boston in the late 1970s: Tristan (Allen Payne), Money (Aaron D. Spears), E-Bone and Simon. With the consent of a South End crime boss, Benny (Clarence Williams III), they quickly rise in the drug game, while the leader of the group, Tristan, keeps his double life a secret from his clueless parents. However, as the 1970s pass to the 2000s, a police investigation threatens to ignite a violent feud among the tight-knit friends.

programme.sub-title: Lull Before the Storm: Between the Wars

programme.title: Patton's Finest Hour: The Battle Of The Bulge
programme.desc: Background of events on Hitler's Ardennes offensive December 1944, with focus on December 19th attack on St. Vith, marking beginning of the Battle of Bulge. Role of 84th infantry division in fighting German army in World War II - penetration of Siegfried Line November 1944, and move into Belgium December 1944.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: At an airfield, Ivan, a new recruit, meets Lyudmila, a skilled pilot concealing an ailment. She mentors him as Lenya, the strict trainer, pushes Martynov, a rebellious trainee. When scouts go missing, aerial battles ensue, forging deep bonds, and unveiling secrets. Amidst peril and personal struggles, they find courage, love, and hope.

programme.title: The Life of Adolf Hitler: Death and Decay
programme.desc: The story of Adolf Hitler from the days of triumph through to the final Götterdämmerung.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: Documentary survey of the activities of the United States Navy leading up to and during the first years of the American war in Vietnam. Footage of American warships during the controversial Gulf of Tonkin incident, which triggered American military action in Vietnam, is shown, as well as depictions of the landing of U.S. Marines on the beaches at Da Nang and Chu Lai.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Kiev, the Ukrainian capital, is, after a lengthy battle, back in Soviet hands. But now they have to clear the Germans and German allies out of the Crimea and liberate the rest of Western Ukraine. Hitler declared the Crimea a 'Festung,' meaning it should be held at all cost and to the last man. The German 17th Army was effectively destroyed in the process.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: The Occult Roots of the Third Reich. The creator of the infamous Gestapo, the Waffen SS and the concentration camp network. Perhaps the strangest individual of all the Nazi crew. Himmler was inspired by mystic visions, runes, horoscopes and a longing for a heroic German past.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: Pearl Harbor day has etched itself in our history. The entire nation was motivated in a fighting fury. We will see the Japanese seize Hong Kong, Singapore, Philippines, and the Dutch East Indies. General McArthur is profiled.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War
programme.desc: In an initial failed attempt to become a partner the equal of Germany in the Axis Alliance, Mussolini ordered his troops towards the British positions in Egypt in September 1940. Mussolini, feeling secure in the shadow of Hitler's apparent invincibility, never dreamt that the War between Britain and Italy would culminate in his own death less than 5 years later.
programme.sub-title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: The War in Italy

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: From the moment Adolf Hitler marched his troops into Poland on the 1st of September 1939, the Second World War was inevitable. As the opening skirmishes are played out, see for yourself the events that shaped the escalating crisis.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As the New Year dawned and the people of Britain faced the introduction of rationing, all eyes turned northwards to Scandinavia. U-Boat attacks increased and at Scapa Flow a German Air Raid claimed the first British casualties.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: This episode takes you through the tense hours of the largest seaborne invasion in history: Operation Neptune, often referred to as D-Day. The operation began the liberation of France and laid the foundations of the Allied victory on the Western Front.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: With the fall of Nazi Germany, the focus shifts to the Pacific, where Japan continues to resist fiercely. This episode covers the brutal island campaigns, kamikaze attacks, and the increasingly destructive U.S. bombing campaigns. Japan's refusal to surrender prompts the U.S. to deploy a new and terrifying weapon: the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Blitzed: Nazis on Drugs
programme.desc: In 1938 a drug called Pervitin was created in Nazi Germany. This drug was distributed to German soldiers during the course of WW2 and Hitler was no exception to these drug highs receiving drug cocktails from his personal physical Theodor Morell. This film explores the use of drugs in WW2 and looks at the potential effects that drugs could have had on Hitler, soldiers and the war itself.

programme.title: Nuclear Test Films
programme.desc: First experimental blast set off in New Mexico; bombing and devastation of Hiroshima and Nagasaki. and devastation of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: Germany, 1933. Adolf Hitler, at the head of the Nazi Party, has just become Chancellor and is faced with leading a republic in the throes of economic crisis and rampant inflation. Hitler used the cult of personality nurtured by his propaganda chief Joseph Goebbels, who spread the Nazis xenophobic and anti-Semitic ideology, which Hitler had been touting since the First World War.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: When American soldiers occupied Germany, they faced orphaned German children resorting to looting. Sergeant Mike Bray was assigned to rectify the situation. He earned the children's trust and helped them establish the Young German Christian Association, restoring an abandoned castle for recreation. The children were sad to see Bray go when he left, grateful for his support.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Leningrad, a vital and large Baltic sea port, is facing the entire weight of Army Group North. The Soviets have no reserves to spare as the Battle of Moscow is about to begin. Wilhelm von Leeb's Army Group North fails to take Leningrad, but begins a horrible siege that will last 872 days, in which over a million civilians will die of starvation and disease.

programme.title: The Human Torpedoes Of WWII
programme.desc: See the history of the mysterious 'Human Torpedoes' of WWII -- and how they originated and developed upon the standard torpedo in top secret.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: This is the thrilling story of one of the most decorated companies in the Army, Company K, 18th Infantry Regiment known as 'The Bloody One'. K is ordered to lay siege to an entire German infantry battalion impregnably fortified on high ground. The heroism of Lt. Johnson and the fearless acts of every soldier in the company are portrayed in this stirring tribute to the rugged men of Company K.

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: On 20 November 1945, the trial of the top brass of the Third Reich, including Göring, opened in Nuremberg, the city where the anti-Jewish laws were drawn up in 1935. One year later, the international military tribunal sentenced 12 of the accused to death, and seven to jail. Some Jewish witnesses testified, and only Hans Frank, the Governor General of Poland, acknowledged the persecution of Jews.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: Six scouts and pilots who excelled in the operation are sent to the capital to receive awards, then given a week's rest at a prestigious boarding house. Meanwhile German saboteurs, posing as the transport plane's commander and radio operator, plan to kill them en route and infiltrate the boarding house to assassinate Soviet command staff.

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: Last in the deeply moving series about the Holocaust. While the hunt to find surviving Nazis continues today, efforts are being made to preserve the memory of their tragic victims.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Gulf War
programme.desc: The war really begins from the moment Saddam Hussein, the president of Iraq, launches his troops into Kuwait. These are spearheaded by 100,000 of his republican guard. Supported by helicopter gunships, armored personnel carriers, mobile artillery and tanks.

programme.title: Inside Hitler's Killing Machine
programme.desc: It is a word that sends a chill down the spine: 'Ahnenerbe'. This was the name of the research institute set up to prove the scientific foundation of Nazi ideology. Driven by a scientific megalomania, the race for new discoveries led the institution to carry out countless acts of barbarism.

programme.title: Great Tank Battles
programme.desc: This first part of the series introduces the first tanks being deployed on the battlefields in northern France during the First World War and describes the devastating effect these steel monsters had on an infantry confronted with them for the very first time. It tracks the development, both technologically and strategically from the Fuller 1919 philosophy through the German attack on Poland.

programme.title: Nazi Concentration Camps
programme.desc: This film is the official documentary report compiled from over 80,000 feet of film shot by Allied military photographers in the German concentration camps immediately after liberation. The footage is a camp-by-camp record taken in order to provide lasting objective proof of the horrors the liberators witnessed. Some emphasis is also placed on the humanitarian work done in camps by the liberators.

programme.title: WWII In Color: US Army Air Forces

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: Fear Factor USA

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to the infamous town of Salem, MA for a pair of baffling cases to uncover what vengeful spirits might still roam this site of centuries-old witch trials and executions. The Lyceum Restaurant was formerly the home of Bridget Bishop, the first woman in Salem executed for suspected witchcraft. Witnesses report frequently seeing the apparition of a woman dressed in period clothing.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS revealsinvestigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the six hour live broadcast from The Waverly Hills Sanatorium. WhenTAPS, along ECW wrestlerElijah Burke,made a return trip to thehospital,nothing could prepare them for what they found.During the investigation Jason and Grant attemptto communicate with the spirit of a young boy who roamsthe halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS sits down with Destination Truth's Josh Gates for an in-depth discussion with TAPS. Jason and Grant will discuss how TAPS came to be and will provide insight and answers to the most chilling and baffling cases. They will talk about their favorite investigations and delve into some hot button issues - like Steve's biggest fears. Then the team takes time to answer important questions from viewers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In the first episode of a brand new season of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to the historic battle field of Ft. Mifflin to uncover the truth behind some ghostly claims. Ft. Mifflin was once the site of bloody battles in both Revolutionary and Civil Wars. Today, visitors and employees tell chilling tales of their brushes with the afterlife. Some claim to have seen apparitions of soldiers, while others report hearing a woman's terrified scream coming from an empty room.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: An urgent call from Dave Tango's father sets the scene for the next case. William Tango, an ex-cop and amateur ghost hunter, was baffled by unexplainable events he experienced on a recent trip to the Burlington County Prison in Mt. Holly, New Jersey. The TAPS team soon discovers William is not alone. Once the site of numerous executions, the prison maintains an unmistakable feeling of dread.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the past nine years unexplainable sounds at the Clapp Library have put Jacques, the night custodian, on edge. The unmistakable sound of books sliding off of shelves and dark shadows moving through the stacks are just some of the eerie events plaguing the library. Desperate to prove to other employees that he's not going crazy, Jacque calls in TAPS to find some answers. During the investigation Jason and Grant hear a strange sound coming from the balcony area.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week the TAPS team heads to the historic Confederate campgrounds of the Cashtown Inn. This old hotel was once the crossroad for Confederate troops on their way to the battle of Gettysburg. The basement of the hotel was later used as a makeshift triage unit, where injured soldiers were often subject to barbaric and crude amputations. Today, hotel guests report countless bizarre experiences, from unexplained sounds in the middle of the night to apparitions roaming the hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, when overwhelming reports of paranormal activity plague the Wright - Patterson Air Force Base, TAPS gets enlisted to help the military. For the past ten years, the air force base has been host to strange experiences. Recent renovations at the base have resulted in escalating activity. At the Arnold House, personnel have reported hearing children's voices and footsteps walking up the stairs. And, in Building 70, ghostly apparitions have put everyone on edge.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS heads to the Mt. Washington Hotel in New Hampshire to be the first paranormal group to investigate this legendary resort. The expansive property sits on top of a massive limestone deposit, known to be a catalyst for paranormal activity. The caretakers here have experienced everything from doors that open and close by themselves to full body apparitions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode, TAPS saddles up and heads west to investigate the legendary Goldfield Hotel in Goldfield, Nevada. This hotel from a bygone era is host to several stories of murder and tragedy. The horrific story of Elizabeth, a woman who was chained to radiator and left for dead, has left many to believe her troubled spirit still haunts the halls. While investigating the second floor, Jason and Grant pursue a solid black mass darting through doorways.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the abandoned Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum. Built in 1858, the asylum was able to accommodate over two thousand patients ranging from deranged violent criminals to the children of the clinically insane. The chilling reports of unexplained sounds, shadowy figures and violent attacks are thought to be the result of restless and tortured spirits still roaming the halls.

programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS heads to Simsbury, CT to the old Pettibone Tavern to solve the legendary story of the ghost of Abigail. The tavern has been a stop off for George Washington, Harriett Beacher Stowe, John Adams. It was used as a stop off for slaves during the underground railroad. Pettibone's daughter Abigail, was married to a sailor.
programme.sub-title: So I Married an Axe Murderer

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to North Kingstown, Rhode Island to investigate the unexplainable paranormal events that are haunting a local restaurant. Linda, the skeptical owner of the Hoofinfeathers Carriage Inn, is hoping to uncover the truth behind the bizarre stories plaguing her establishment. The reports of disembodied voices and phantom-like apparitions have frightened some of her guests and terrorized her staff.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS returns to Buffalo, NY to investigate the abandoned remains of the Buffalo Central Terminal. Once lively, it was a hub of transportation, but in 1979, the last train left the station and the terminal closed its doors for good. Today, the terminal has started to undergo substantial renovations which some believe stirred up the ghostly entities that dwell there.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Ocala, Florida to investigate an old inn. The Inn has seen numerous stories from a housekeeper being knocked and held down on the floor to the sighting of a cigar smoking man. Full-bodied apparitions have been spotted everywhere and employees have mentioned on several occasions tripping and falling down the stairs only to be stopped in mid-fall by something and saved from crashing through the wall or window.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to New Orleans to investigate an old Creole Plantation in the heart of the bayou. Oak Alley Plantation was settled by French settlers and became a booming operation that produced sugar cane and pecans. In the alley of oak trees the sounds of a carriage is heard coming up the lane and sometimes even dust blows up giving the appearance that a carriage is moving towards the home. This is a place where rich history is surrounded by the grim realities of life way back when.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, a frightened, young mother asks TAPS to help her terrorized son. The first time Heather brought her son Aiden home she noticed what sounded like a man whispering coming through on his radio. This home has been replaced with ghostly shadows and toys that inexplicably turn themselves on at night.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS follows up a TAPS Family investigation that may have turned up the paranormal activity in a residential home to 11. Troy LeBlanc's 19th century 4400 sq.ft. Victorian home is with two separate living quarters-Troy lives in the upstairs portion, his parents downstairs. When he first bought the house, there were constant footsteps coming from all over the house and doors would fly open and hit Troy.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

Arthur tells his life story to the priest, which begins with him stealing valuables from the deceased as a youth. But as he relates his battles with zombies, ghosts and other fiendish ghouls, his tale takes a turn for the supernatural.

Corky persuades Peggy to leave her loveless marriage -- but Fats, who seems to be taking on a mind of his own, doesn't approve of the relationship.

programme.desc: When mankind perfects time travel, the government establishes the Time Enforcement Commission to thwart criminal attempts to alter the timeline. Police officer Walker (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is recruited by TEC Cmdr. Matuzak (Bruce McGill), but soon finds his investigation of Senator Aaron McComb (Ron Silver) being thwarted by elements within the government. When Walker's wife, Melissa (Mia Sara), is attacked, he must travel across time to rescue her and save the future.

programme.title: Before The Devil Knows You're Dead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Andy needs some quick cash gets his younger brother into a scheme to rob their parents' jewelry store.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Theatrical Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit crimes.

programme.title: The Lost Princess
programme.desc: A billionaire gets transported to a bloody battle that leads him to an old castle in Morocco. He soon meets Hanna, who shares the tragic tale of her mother's forced marriage to a Saudi prince, and her secret love affair with a castle caretaker.

programme.title: The Fix
programme.desc: When a troubled model takes a new drug at a party, she suffers a shocking transformation. Pursued by authorities and a dangerous gang, she hunts for a 'fix' to reverse these effects, only to discover her mutations could save the human race.

programme.title: I'm Beginning to See the Light
programme.desc: After losing his family in a brutal accident, ex-trumpeter Ezra finds solace as a lighthouse keeper. But when two visitors reveal their true motives, Ezra must decide: let the light back into his life or stay in the shadows.

programme.title: White Bird in a Blizzard
programme.desc: A teenager (Shailene Woodley) relishes her newfound freedom after her disturbed mother (Eva Green) vanishes, but the strange facts of the disappearance soon begin to haunt her.

programme.title: In the Fade
programme.desc: Katja's life falls apart in the blink of an eye when two neo-Nazis kill her husband and 6-year-old son in a bomb attack. Her quest for justice soon pushes her to the edge as the two suspects stand trial for murder.

programme.title: Shadow Dancer
programme.desc: Arrested after a failed bombing attempt, a single mother and IRA member (Andrea Riseborough) falls into the hands of a British agent (Clive Owen) who offers her a choice: Spy on her IRA comrades, or spend a long prison term away from her young son.

programme.title: The World's Fastest Indian
programme.desc: New Zealander Burt Munro spent years perfecting his classic Indian motorcycle. The year is 1967, and Burt takes his machine to Utah's salt flats, where he attempts the impossible, using his dream bike to set a new world's record for speed. Based on a true story, the record Munro set more than three decades ago still has not been broken to this day.

programme.title: Tangerine
programme.desc: After hearing that her boyfriend/pimp cheated on her while she was in jail, a transgender sex worker and her best friend set out to find him and teach him and his new lover a lesson.

programme.title: All Good Things
programme.desc: Heir to a real-estate dynasty, David Marks (Ryan Gosling) lives in the shadow of his father, Sanford (Frank Langella). He takes a chance at true love when he meets Katie (Kirsten Dunst), a woman of modest origins who sees David's real worth as a person, not just his family's wealth. David and Katie marry and plan to build a life together, but their once-loving relationship deteriorates after David gives in to his father's demand that he work in the family business.

programme.title: Skate Kitchen
programme.desc: Camille's life as a lonely suburban teenager changes dramatically when she befriends a group of girl skateboarders. As she journeys deeper into this raw New York City subculture, she begins to understand the true meaning of friendship.

programme.title: A Kind of Murder
programme.desc: Walter Stackhouse is rich, successful and unhappily married to the beautiful but damaged Clara. His desire to be free of her feeds his obsession with Kimmel, a man suspected of brutally murdering his own wife. When Walter and Kimmel's lives become dangerously intertwined, a ruthless police detective becomes convinced he has found the murderer. But as the lines blur between innocence and intent, who, in fact, is the real killer?

programme.title: Cashback
programme.desc: Would-be artist Ben (Sean Biggerstaff) realizes he has an extraordinary way of dealing with the tedium of his dead-end job stocking shelves at a store - he has acquired the ability to halt time and explore the world while the rest of the earth's population remains frozen in place. Ben's unusual talent helps him forget about a nasty breakup with his ex-girlfriend Suzy (Michelle Ryan), but he begins to stop time so often that he may miss out on a new romance with his coworker Sharon (Emilia Fox).

programme.title: The Good Heart
programme.desc: Homeless and saved from almost certain death by a hospital staff, Lucas (Paul Dano) has nowhere to turn. The hospital staffers, though, are so taken with his kindness and generosity that they take up a collection to give him a fresh start. But when he's discharged, Lucas meets some fellow homeless people and gives away all the money he's just received. His roommate at the hospital, Jacques (Brian Cox), is also affected by the young man, and offers him a job at his bar.

programme.title: Ondine
programme.desc: Fisherman Syracuse (Colin Farrell), a recovering alcoholic, lives with his daughter, Annie (Alison Barry), in a small village on the Irish coast. One afternoon, a mystifying and beautiful girl, Ondine (Alicja Bachleda), gets caught in his nets as he wades along the water. Aboard the boat, Ondine brings Syracuse great luck, seemingly drawing the fish towards his nets. However, the fisherman starts to fear that Ondine may not be meant for this life.

programme.title: A Long Way Down
programme.desc: Four strangers who planned to jump off the same roof on New Year's Eve join together as a kind of family and give themselves six weeks to find valid reasons to live.

programme.title: Mr. Nobody: Extended Director's Cut
programme.desc: In 2092, the last mortal human on Earth reflects on his long past and thinks about the lives he might have led.

programme.title: Please Stand By
programme.desc: Wendy sees things differently: she's fiercely independent, with a brilliant mind and a mischievous sense of hilarity. Wendy also has autism. To her, people are an indecipherable code and the world's a confusing place. Inspired by her no-nonsense caregiver, Wendy comes of age and escapes from her care home on the road trip of a lifetime to deliver her 500-page script to a writing competition.

programme.title: Prince Avalanche
programme.desc: Two road-crew workers (Paul Rudd, Emile Hirsch) spend the summer of 1988 isolated and away from their city lives, eventually finding themselves at odds with each other and their women back home.

programme.title: Nobody Walks
programme.desc: A young woman's (Olivia Thirlby) arrival sparks a surge of energy into a laid-back, artistic Los Angeles household, forcing the residents to confront their own fears and desires in an intricate dance of lust, denial and deception.

programme.title: Main Street
programme.desc: A stranger (Colin Firth) becomes involved with the close-knit residents of a North Carolina town after he arrives with a controversial plan to save their crumbling community.

programme.title: Compliance
programme.desc: A fast-food worker (Dreama Walker) who's accused of theft is put through the wringer as her boss (Ann Dowd), at the direction of a phone caller who says he's a cop, subjects her to increasingly harsh forms of interrogation.
A man (Anthony Hopkins) searches for his missing daughter in one of several vignettes dealing with issues of love, loss and betrayal.
