programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: With the oven on, Lidia creates sweet and savory dishes her viewers can easily make at home. Gratins are delicious, and she starts with a Leek and Prosciutto Gratin made with Gruyère and walnuts; next is Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate, marvelously moist inside and with a crispy, caramelized exterior. While the oven is still on, she bakes crumbly and chewy Raspberry and Walnut Butter Cookies for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fuzi with chicken ragu; no-bake chocolate ricotta brick cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Penne with cauliflower and green olive pesto; poached chicken and giardiniera salad.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fried potatoes with sausage and eggs; breakfast risotto featuring bacon, egg and cheese; ricotta pancakes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American food: Is it Italian, American or a piece of Americana with Italian roots? Today Lidia pays homage to the cooking of Italian American immigrants. Recipes include: Caesar Salad; a luscious Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables; and finally Stuffed Mushrooms, a true crowd pleaser.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia remembers Grandma Rosa's olive trees and the excitement surrounding the late fall harvest of one of Italy's most prized products- newly pressed extra virgin olive oil. Lidia's recipes in this episode showcase this treasured product and include a delicate Striped Bass with Braised Broccolini and Olive Oil Cake, a culinary creation that is perfect for a snack, breakfast, and dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Potato and pasta soup; a salad of green beans and new potatoes; ditalini with potatoes and provoke.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves bringing people together in her kitchen, and she shares two recipes that are wonderful for a buffet-style meal, her favorite way of entertaining guests. She starts with a quick and easy Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini with a sauce of garlic, butter, white wine, lemon, bread crumbs and parsley. Next on the menu is one of Lidia's favorite soups, Clam Soup, served with plenty of grilled bread on the side.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It doesn't get any better in an Italian kitchen than when Lidia makes fish and vegetables. In this episode, she prepares a nice and refreshing Pan Seared Shrimp with Arugula Pesto. Her next dish is Butterflied Trout, fried in a pan with Bacon and Basil served with a Zucchini Dish made with Anchovies and Capers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is all about feeding a large crowd, and Lidia cooks up recipes that all your guests will love, no matter whom you are hosting - Sausages and Apples, a flavorful one-pot meal that is great for family-style dining; Spaghetti with Roasted Garlic Pesto, a delicious and economical addition to any party; and finally, Chocolate Ricotta Cheesecake, a chocolatey twist to the classic Italian ricotta cheesecake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Everyone loves pasta, and today Lidia shows you the fun and economical way to make all your friends and family happy at the dinner table with a pasta party. On the menu is Spaghetti with Anchovies and Breadcrumbs, a delicious Southern Italian favorite; a Pasta Chinja - a heart-warming Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs and Egg. Finally, Lidia will share her Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto - a complex bowl of pasta that will become a staple in your house.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing like a warm oven that makes guests feel invited in a kitchen. The heat and the aromas permeate and bring smiles to everyone's faces. In this episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite oven baked dishes. Eggplant and Rice Parmigiana, Vegetable and Meat Casserole, Bread Puddign with Pears.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia constantly cherishes the memory of baking bread with her Grandma Rosa. As simple as it was, there is nothing that could take away how powerful this culinary experience was for her. Lidia starts off with a quick and easy Onion Tomato Focaccia, and then talks about Taralli, crunchy little bread rings that are a treat in southern Italy. She then makes Pizza Rolls with two uniquely Italian fillings- broccoli rabe and sausage, and ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fettuccine with caramelized onions, bacon and olives; orange spritz; roast chicken with rosemary and lemon.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grilled lamb chops are always delicious but n this episode, Ldiia sears them in a heavy skillet, pressing them down so that all the surface get crisp. She serves the chops with a simple yet elegant red wine sauce with dried cherries, garlic and bay leaves and rosemary. Served with a Tasty Potato Salad and finished with beautiful Almond and Coffee Cream Mini Tarts, this is a meal that everyone will love!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia believes in cooking according to season, and when springtime comes, she and her family all work well to create a beautiful garden. In this episode, she shares four delicious recipes that celebrate the bounty of the summertime garden. Tuna Salad with Boiled Zucchini, String Bean Salad with Capers and Basil, Whole Wheat Cous with Cucumbers, and finally Shells with Chicken and Zucchini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about the balance today as Lidia pairs some unexpected ingredients that result in the best of flavors. She starts the meal with her Prosciutto and Fig Bruschetta: grilled bread topped with a salty sweet combination of prosciutto and fig jam; Spaghetti with Fennel and Bitter Greens: spaghetti tossed with fennel, escarole and a splash of balsamic; Chocolate Anise Biscotti: the "twice cooked" Italian cookie made with chocolate and anise.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Celebrating the late-summer harvest with oat risotto with butternut squash and sunchokes; stuffed mushrooms; one-bowl olive oil cake and red wine poached pears.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing like pasta to bring the Lidia's family to the table. In this episode Lidia shares some of her favorite pasta dishes including a comforting Baked Rigatoni with Zucchini , a delicious Penne with Ricotta and Mushrooms and one of her personal favorites, Fettuccine with a Clam and Leek Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Bergamot and ricotta parfait with nougatine and toasted almonds; almond tart; chocolate anise biscotti.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia introduces this episode with "Beautiful vegetables and a hot oven: a great marriage!" She then begins the meal with a simple and refreshing Sesame and Fava Bean Dip, perfect for flatbreads. Next, she prepares a Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables, topped with a golden, cheesy crust. Her unique version of Baked Potatoes is made with Pancetta and Oregano.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is a celebration of some of Lidia's favorite comfort foods. The combination of potaoes and pasta in one dish is not unusual in Italy and in her Pippette with Sweet Potatoes, Lidia adds a beloved American ingredient to give it a nutritious and complex finish. Veal Stew with Onion and Squash is the perfect one-pot meal, in which the protein and vegetables come together.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves a good roast. It brings out unimaginable flavors, and the aromas from the kitchen will beckon your family to the table. Today's menu includes Red Onions Stuffed with Rice; a Roast Pork Shoulder with Roast Vegetable Sauce, and a brown sugar, bourbon and warm Baked Pineapple served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. She'll also show you how to prepare an easy dessert spread with seasonal fruits and a few store-bought sweet Italian specialties.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian cuisine is known for seasonal ingredients and simple techniques. In today's episode, Lidia will share recipes that master simplicity: Sausages with Fennel & Olives; Orange and Red Salad and a delicious "Almost a Tiramisu" recipe.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a young girl, from a small, rural setting, the majestic skyscrapers of Manhattan were quite the sight for Lidia. As a young teenager, Lidia was in charge of most dinners since her parents were returning home late in the evening, and soups were a popular choice to feed the family. In this episode, Lidia prepares a filling meal of Potato and Pasta Soup followed by Polenta with Honey and Berries, an easy way to use leftover polenta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Yellow saffron seafood and leek risotto; how to replenish stock using food scraps from the freezer; barley risotto with cabbage and sausage.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The egg is a staple ingredient in any kitchen and should not be overlooked or overcooked. In this episode, Lidia shows you the classic technique of poaching an egg and making a Warm Mushroom Salad: a bed of frisee with a warm medley of mixed wild mushrooms, pancetta and a poached egg; Eggs Poached in Tomato Sauce: a simple and delicious tomato Sauce poached egg served with slices of grilled country bread and Brutti ma Buoni, a classic Italian hazelnut cookie made with meringue.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Tomatoes make the perfect canvas for any recipe, and in today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite dishes featuring this juicy, delicious staple of Italian cuisine. Her menu includes Eggs Poached in Tomato Sauce, served over easy on top of a crunchy slice of grilled country bread; Stuffed Tomatoes, filled with a classic combination of rice, mozzarella and basil.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pasta primavera "new school" with creamy pesto loaded with fresh vegetables; penne with vodka sauce; cavatappi with asparagus and spinach pesto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Halibut with saffron fregola; tuna and chickpea salad; shrimp alla Buonavia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Celebrating the late-summer harvest with oat risotto with butternut squash and sunchokes; stuffed mushrooms; one-bowl olive oil cake and red wine poached pears.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia prepares a large pot of bubbling polenta, a dish that she grew up with and loved. From that polenta, she'll bake Crostini with Mixed Mushrooms and Cheese which is a perfect starter to any meal. Her granddaughter, Julia, joins her in the kitchen to help assemble and of course, taste! She'll then prepare a Hearty Polenta Dish with Bacon and Broccoli, a perfect combination. Finally, she'll make Sweet Skillet Sausage with Mixed Grapes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about freash seafood in this episode with three of Lidia's most requested fish recipes: Clam Brushetta features crusty Italian bread, still warm from the grill with clam sauce; Halibut Baked with Mushrooms in a Lemon and White Wine Sauce is a great weekend meal as is Grouper with Potatoes and Peppers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about the grill today since Italians love a "grigliata mista" or Italian grilled platters of meats, seafood and vegetables. Today, Lidia shares a menu that your guests will love as well. On the menu is Grilled Calamari Salad with Tomato Coulis; Grilled Apple and Radicchio Salad with Gorgonzola and a flavorful Tuscan Maremma Style Steak.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The oven is on in Lidia's kitchen, and she is using it for sweet and savory dishes. To start, she makes a springtime crunchy, Cheese Roasted Asparagus dish. Next is a family favorite, Baked Eggplant with Tomatoes, created with cheese, herbs and topped with a baked egg. Then it's time for sweets as she prepares an Almond Torte with Chocolate Chips served with a mound of whipped cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Southern Italian-style bruschetta; tomato and Tropea onion salad featuring crispy friselle bread; spicy bloody mary; panzerotti.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians don't like to eat big pieces of meat, but they do like to braise small pieces with lots of vegetables into delicious ragus. In this episode, Lidia creates a delicious meal of Celery Stalks Stuffed with Gorgonzola and Apples; mouthwatering Lamb Ragu prepared with an array of peppers and potatoes and for a sweet finish, a Gianduia Cake made of hazelnuts and chocolate- a Piedmontese tradition.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Casseroles have a place in everyone's heart and home. Today Lidia shares a delicious and hearty Italian style version of Layered Casserole of Beef, Cabbage and Potatoes topped with fontina cheese - a one pot meal fit to feed any hungry crowd. Lidia then stews apples and dried fruit in her Spiced Fruit Compote and adds spices like clove and cinnamon - a heartwarming tea; Lastly, she is joined by Grandma for her Coffee Panna Cotta, an easy make-ahead dessert flavored with coffee and Sambuca.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Slow cooking does take a little time, but it is so rewarding! Today Lidia shares some classic techniques that will make show-stopping dishes for any occasion. Lidia prepares an elegant Risotto with Mushrooms, finished with parsley, cheese and butter. She'll then prepare a luscious Ziti with Pork Rib Guazzetto. Lidia then shows you how breathe new life into your risotto leftovers by breading it and frying it to make a delicious snack or serve it over a salad for a complete meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American classics are what Lidia discovered as a young 12 year old arriving in America. In this episode, she shares some of her favorites: Bolognese Sauce; Asparagus Salad and a lighter and more contemporary version of the Chicken Pizzaiola.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Summer is the time of year when some of Lidia's favorite vegetables and fruits are at their best. Today, she shares some recipes that she loves making at home when entertaining, including Corn and Zucchini Minestra; Shrimp and Mixed Bean Salad, a salad that is always part of the buffet table in Lidia's home; and lastly, Polenta with Honey and Berries, a recipe Lidia has loved since she was a little girl.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Orecchiette with breadcrumbs, pancetta, and cauliflower; crespelle with wild cherries, chocolate, and whipped cream; lemon ice.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Are you always in rush to prepare soemthing quick yet delicious for dinnertime? In this episode Lidia shares three of her favorite quick and simple meal ideas-all of which can work as an appetizer, a lunch or quick dinner. They include Scallops, Scallion and Mushrooms, Chicken Breasts with Orange and Gaeta Olives, Tuna with Mimosa Sauce

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American cuisine has a unique history and continues to evolve with time. Lidia will demonstrate one of the traditional favorites - Spaghetti with Meatballs - before sharing a more contemporary Pork Chop Milanese that is a favorite in one of her restaurants.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a seasonal meal that says "Family Time " Pork and Grapes are a natural combination, and in today's menu, she prepares Pork Medallions with grapes, Baked Fennel with Sage and for dessert, a colorful and perfect cold weather Ornage in Marsala for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian sweets are today's focus and include: Blueberry and Ricotta Parfait; Chocolate Zabaglione and Raspberry & Walnut Butter Cookies

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves long cooking techniques and braising but often, one just wants to prepare quick and delicious meals using the same technique. In this episode, she teaches the viewer to do just that. Her first dish is a velvety Lettuce Soup in a Fontina Gratin; she then makes a juicy but super quick Pork Tenderloin with Balsamic Onions. Lastly, she prepares String Beans with Rocky Mashed Potatoes made with garlic and olive oil.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Crostini with fresh tomatoes and ricotta; warm crostini with smothered kale and melty fontina; monkfish brodetto with cannellini; garlic bread three ways.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Lidia was in her 20's, she opened Buonavia, her first restaurant, in Queens, New York. Her menu there included Italian American favorites, served alongside some of her favorite dishes from her homeland. In this episode, she prepares popular dishes from this first eatery including: a rich and flavorful Beef and Potato Goulash, and a sweet and simple Crespelle with Wild Cherries, Chocolate, and Whipped Cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia reminisces about her childhood chores, which included milking the goats and helping her grandmother prepare ricotta and other cheeses. In this episode, she will celebrate the culture of cheese and prepare the following recipes: Crostini Two Ways, using Tomato and Ricotta plus Kale and Fontina. Her next recipe is a hearty and cheesy dish of Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Southern Italian-style bruschetta; tomato and Tropea onion salad featuring crispy friselle bread; spicy bloody mary; panzerotti.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As Lidia works in her garden, she reminisces about her childhood and of the lessons that Grandma Rosa taught her about her vegetable patch. In the kitchen, she makes a Country Salad as well as Green Beans with New Potatoes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's another episode dedicated to simplicity and delicious ingredients. Here Lidia chooses three great dishes that can be made in very little time but offer great flavors and complexity. They are great as appetizers, sides or by themselves and include Caprese Salad with Celery and Walnuts, Stuffed Artichokes with Tuna and Scallop Salad
programme.sub-title: Quick Light and Easy Meal Ideas

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today it's all about the braise. To start, Lidia makes a unique Salad of Radicchio and Oranges, a perfect blend of bitter and sweet. She then makes a heartwarming Braised Chicken Thigh dish with Potatoes and Olives, a family favorite. For another braise, she demonstrates a simple technique with cauliflower that brings out the nutty flavor of this underused vegetable.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love to drink wine with their meals and cook with it as well. In this episode, Lidia shares a meal where wine plays a part of each delicious dish: Sausage Crostini: a toasted piece of bread topped with sweet Italian sausage and topped with taleggio cheese; Linguine with White Clam Sauce: a simple white wine clam sauce served with linguine pasta; Braised Beef Rolls: stuffed beef rolls oozing with the flavors of prosciutto, provolone and golden raisins served in a red wine tomato sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Everybody loves pasta! In this episode, Lidia starts with the simplest- a Spaghettini with Olive Oil and Rosemary, then moves on to a hearty dish of Tagliatelle with Metaballs and eggplant, and finishes with a delicious whole wheat pasta - Baked Whole Wheat Penne with Ceci Beans.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia tosses arborio rice with olives, roasted peppers, artichokes, and provolone to create a satisfying and vibrant "Antipasto" Rice Salad. She also pulls together a Sauteed Chicken dressed in a Bright Lemon Caper Sauce over Spinach.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Kale salad with avocado and pistachios; marinara sauce; no-mess cheesy baked chicken wings.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia talks about growing up and family traditions in this episode. Featured recipes include Shrimp and Mixed Bean Salad, a Roasted Garlic Crostini and Papperdelle with Mixed Fresh Mushrooms. A refreshing "Panache" is shared with her mother Erminia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is all about rice, and Lidia teaches viewers how to master the technique of making risotto. She starts with an Italian classic, Risotto with Mushrooms; next is Red Onions Stuffed with Rice. No food should be wasted, and Lidia shows viewers how to use risotto leftovers by making Fried Risotto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Skillet shrimp with asparagus features sauteed shrimp over grilled bread; skillet gratinate of pork, aubergine and zucchini; one-pot soft polenta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grains are back in style, yet Italians have been using them for centuries. Lidia shares some of her favorite grain based recipes in this episode including: Risotto with Mushrooms; Barley, Kale & Butternut Squash Risotto; and Polenta Torta with Gorgonzola and Savory Cabbage.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: This episode features a "Best of Chicken" with some of Lidia's favorite dishes from the oven to the stovetop. Recipes include a succulent Roasted Chicken; a simple and earthy Seared Chicken Breast with Mushrooms; and finally a dish with a little kick - Paprika Drumsticks with Peppers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Steak is a favorite in many American households, and this episode is a tribute to the nice juicy dish and showcase not only one of Lidia's preferred preparations but two other recipes that work well for a special steak house evening at home. Featured recipes include Seared Steak with Mushroom Sauce and Braised Escarole; Baked Potatoes with Pancetta and Oregano; and an Almond Cake with Chocolate Chips.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love their seasons, and they know how to make delicious soups, salads and pastas with fall and winter vegetables. In this episode, Lidia shares some winter garden menu ideas including a spicy Escarole and White Bean Soup, a unique and delicious Spaghetti with Fennel and Bitter Greens and a Cabbage Salad made with warm bacon dressing.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fried potatoes with sausage and eggs; breakfast risotto featuring bacon, egg and cheese; ricotta pancakes.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: The Improbable Grill: In this show we explore three unexpected techniques for grilling. The first stands the vertical rotisserie used in Mexico and the Middle East. The second involves a piece of equipment you don't usually find at a barbecue-a roofer's torch. The third involves a mystery ingredient that virtually no one on the planet has ever grilled.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - The Improbable Grill

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Cured and Smoked: In humankind's long march to food security, two ancient preserving techniques have stood out over the millennia: curing and smoking. The first involves preserving foods with salt, soy sauce, or sodium nitrite, and the second technique involves blasting foods with flavorful clouds of wood smoke. Today, we're pushing the envelope on traditional curing and smoking.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Cured and Smoked

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Maryland Crab Feast: This show focuses on my favorite food growing up: callinectes sapidus, better known as the Maryland blue crab. Maryland seafood markets and restaurants come alive with soft shell crabs, eaten shell and all, traditionally deep-fried, here seared over live fire. Which brings us to the summum of the Maryland crab experience: a crab feast known as Maryland steamed crabs.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Maryland Crab Feast

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Raichlen's Rules: Desserts: Take your desserts to a new level of flavor with Grilled Pound Cake with Berry Salsa and Smoked Whipped Cream, Salt Slab-Grilled Pears with Amaretti And Smoked Whipped Cream, Dessert Quesadillas, Smoked Ice Cream with Rum Raisin Sauce.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Raichlen's Rules Desserts

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Let Texans brag about brisket and Carolinians praise pulled pork shoulder. For the rest of us, the ultimate symbol of barbecue is ribs. In the American Midwest, ribs mean baby backs or other pork ribs, while in Korea, the bone of choice is the beef short rib. In the eastern Mediterranean, lamb ribs reign supreme. In this show we give you three of the best ribs ever.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Best Ribs Ever

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Barbecue Health Food: A little-known fact-Steven Raichlen's first James Beard Award-winning book wasn't about barbecue, but a book on healthy eating. This show harnesses the flavor- boosting, fat-melting power of live fire to produce grilled fare that not only tastes good but is good for you. From the paellas of Spain to the grilled beef salads of Southeast Asia.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Barbecue Health Food

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Steak. Few other words in the English language have such power to make our hearts beat faster and our mouths water than sizzling slabs of beef seared over live fire. In this show we embark on some meaty globe hopping, exploring over-the-top steaks from France, Cambodia, and the American Southwest. Hot fire. Sizzling meat. It's a carnivore's dream come true.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Planet Steak

programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Zagreb

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: At the Mercato Centrale in San Lorenzo, one can taste the best food treasures Tuscany has on offer: from the olive oil of the Fiesole hills to the onions of the medieval borough of Certaldo and up to the Natural Reserve of San Marcello with its Tuscan cured meats. Here the simple and genuine tastes are king.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Firenze

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The largest indoor market in Budapest is also the most elegant in Europe! Spanning over three levels, the impressive central food market is long recognized as a marvel. Whether it be the freshest fish, the richest goose liver, or the sweetest paprika that you're looking for, you'll find it. But don't forget the basement: this is where you will find the very best pickled cabbage in the country!
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Budapest

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Food markets have a strong tradition in the Netherlands and many citizens count on their long street markets for their fresh food supplies. One of the oldest and most famous markets of the Netherlands is the Albert Cuyp Markt, a street market stretching along the upcoming (and "hip") neighborhood of de Pijp.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Amsterdam

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Perhaps one of the most beautiful and well-organized food market buildings in Europe is the Mercado Central of Valencia. Built on the area where an open-air market stood for centuries, the Valencian style Art Noveau construction is a 'Cathederal of senses'.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Valencia

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: In this episode, we'll travel the BBQ trail from Venezuela to Peru, starting with a Venezuelan specialty-Asopao (seafood rice), reimagined here on the grill by Caracas-born chef Geronimo Lopez. And then a twist on two Peruvian delicacies-Tuna Anticuchos (kebabs) and Smoke-Roasted Peruvian Potato Salad.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - From Caracas to Lima

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: Brazilians are world masters at the art of the rotisserie. In this show, learn to cook beef, chickenand pork with the proverbial turn. We start with Brazil's celebrated Picanha (fat cap sirloin)-served with farofa and Country-Style Salsa. Next, Brazilian Pork Loin grilled with Bacon and Prunes, and finally, Rio Chicken Rollatini. So put on some samba music and get ready to rock the grill.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - The Brazilian Grill

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: The Caribbean occupies a special place in the annals of barbecue. Taino Indian barbacoa-seafood and meats smoke-roasted on a wooden platform that gave us the word "barbecue." The Caribbean remains a hotbed of barbecue delights; Jamaican Jerk Chicken, Trinidadian grilled vegetable dip called Choka and Shrimp Boka Dushi-a spicy Dutch West Indian kebab whose name literally means "happy mouth."
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Fire and Spice

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: Texas BBQ to many means brisket, but in this show, you'll experience the Texas Trinity: Grilled Quail with Pear Salsa and Blue Cheese Farroto prepared by San Antonio master chef Jason Dady. Smoked and Grilled Rib-Eye Steaks accompanied by Smashed Potatoes. And a sizzling sandwich, a Hot Gut Hero (beef sausage with pepper Jack cheese). It's the Texas Trinity hot off the grill.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Texas Trinity

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: Across Latin America, grilling styles vary: Argentine and Uruguayan masters embrace simplicity, seasoning steaks with just salt. In contrast, Mexican chefs layer bold flavors-marinating meats in recados and adobos, wrapping them in aromatic leaves, and searing over hardwood fires. Here are three spectacular Mexican grilling specialties that showcase this rich, fiery tradition.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: San Antonio is the home base for this season of Planet Barbecue. One of only two cities in the U.S. designated a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy, the Alamo City boasts a cuisine as colorful as its historic city center. Get ready for Carne Asado Breakfast Tacos, Jason Dady's Oak-Smoked Cherry-Glazed Ribs, and Beef Cheek Barbacoa prepared by local smoke master Esaul Ramos.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - San Antonio Grill

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: When Columbus landed in what is now the Bahamas in 1492, he initiated an East-West culinary exchange that continues to this day. This show explores three European grill classics-each with a New World twist. From Wood-Grilled Gazpacho with Serrano Ham Crisps to a unique Pearl District Spiessbraten served with Jicama Salad. And for dessert? Spectacular Smoked, Torched Creme Brulée.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Grilling from Across the Pond

programme.title: Serial Griller
programme.desc: Matt Moore kicks off Serial Griller with "Hot Handhelds," grilling up bold favorites like Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwiches, Pork Gyros, char-grilled hot dogs, wings with blue cheese, and the juicy Hemingway Burger. No forks required!

programme.title: Serial Griller
programme.desc: Matt Moore grills for friends, serving sausage, blade steaks, redneck potatoes, and a Bardstown Buck cocktail.

programme.title: Serial Griller
programme.desc: In "All the Courses," Matt Moore celebrates East Nashville's Tomato Fest with a feast-Breakfast Pizzette, Tuna Nicoise, Scored Flank Steak with Dijon Caper Sauce, and Grilled Watermelon. A multi-course grilling adventure with Southern flair!

programme.title: Serial Griller
programme.desc: Host Matt Moore brings East and West together over charcoal on the Ammo Grill. Inspired by his travels to Japan and the renowned Hikiniku To Come experience, Matt serves up juicy Wagyu Hamburger Steaks alongside a lineup of crowd-pleasing favorites. The menu includes Chili Cheese Dawgs, Salmon Kabobs, and Bacon-Bratwurst Fried Rice, each showcasing bold flavors and live-fire cooking techniques.

programme.title: Serial Griller

Drawing from his Lebanese and Syrian heritage, Matt starts with grilled beef kefta pitas before serving a smoky grilled Caesar salad and juicy grilled chicken thighs topped with vibrant salsa verde.

programme.title: Serial Griller
programme.desc: Matt Moore showcases the versatility and convenience of gas grilling on the Napoleon Rogue Pro-S in an all-day celebration of outdoor cooking. Then, a Greek-inspired rotisserie beer can chicken with drip potatoes delivers a flavorful one-pan feast.

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty harvests his spuds and sows seeds for autumn veg. He also shows how to get plants for free by taking cuttings.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: A celebration of people who are growing their own, from vegetables to flowers, across the UK. At Longmeadow, Monty shares tips and advice on how to get the most out of bargain plants. Meanwhile, Joe visits an extraordinary food project in Bristol.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Frances Tophill is in her very first garden for a summer catch-up and an update on her progress since moving in. Meanwhile, Adam Frost meets a kindred spirit who explains how gardening saved his life.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty plants for pollinators in the Wildlife Garden and trims his box topiary cones. He also takes succulent leaf cuttings and continues the summer veg harvest. Meanwhile, Carol Klein visits stunning Italian-influenced gardens in Gloucestershire.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty shows how to take cuttings from herbs, prune summer raspberries and plant daylilies. Meanwhile, Adam travels to Whitstable on the Kent coast to see how gardeners cope with the wild, wet and windy weather.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With autumn just around the corner, Adam takes stock of his garden and plans ahead for some late-season interest under the supervision of Ash the cat. Plus, Frances visits a garden in Kent where the plants provide a non-stop buffet for insects.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty plants bulbs in pots, including hyacinths and daffodils. He shares tips and advice on what to do when apples and pears have been affected by diseases such as canker and brown rot. Plus, he gives a timely guide on how to collect and save seeds.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty considers a revamp of his cottage garden, divides perennials to get new plants for free and plants bulbs in pots for spring.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: A celebration of people who are growing their own, from vegetables to flowers, across the UK. At Longmeadow, Monty shares tips and advice on how to get the most out of bargain plants. Meanwhile, Joe visits an extraordinary food project in Bristol.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty revels in the roses in his garden, harvests honey from his bees and gives advice on the maintenance of hardy geraniums as well as planting others for summer ground cover. Rachel de Thame shows how the most ordinary of spaces can be transformed by adding seasonal containers.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Charge your glasses as Joe Swift visits a 'drinkable' allotment in London where much of the produce is grown to make beer, wine and cider. In the first of a five-part series about botany, Carol Klein looks at the capsules of potential that herald the start and end of most plants' lives: seeds.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: One couple battle to turn a clay-clogged building site in Sussex into a piece of Portugal. Another tackle a forest of overgrowth in their new back garden in Cadeby. They are determined to create a productive space, something they have always wanted.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: A truck driver from Wakefield with a passion for flowers wants to create a perfect outside space for his girlfriend and burgeoning family, while in Swindon a widow wants to find the best way of turning her bleak patch of green into a cottage garden.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty travels to two corners of the country where the challenges he faces are very different. On the south coast he is presented with a front garden ravaged by salty winds, and in Snowdonia he helps a mountainside garden.

programme.title: Kew on a Plate
programme.desc: It is spring at Kew and after a long, dark winter, nature is coming back to life. Raymond makes his sublime version of rhubarb and custard and Kate finds out how a 12-year-old slave enabled vanilla to become the world's most popular flavour.

programme.title: Kew on a Plate
programme.desc: Summer has arrived at Kew and everything in Raymond Blanc and Kate Humble's garden is blooming. Butterflies and bees abound and there are new crops to tend, harvest and cook with. Everyone loves a carrot, particularly the carrot fly, so Raymond must protect his crop to ensure he has a good supply for his summer carrot stew.

programme.title: Kew on a Plate
programme.desc: It's autumn at Kew and the vegetable garden is set to produce a bumper harvest. Raymond Blanc and Kate Humble grow some autumnal favourites and cook them up. Kate finds out why the tomato was once considered to be a deadly poison.

programme.title: Kew on a Plate
programme.desc: The end of the year at Kew is fast approaching, winter is setting in, but some crops positively love the cold and Raymond learns how brassicas cope in this frosty season. Kate visits Kew's Millennium Seed Bank.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Presenting from York Gate in Leeds, Adam Frost, Rachel de Thame and Frances Tophill celebrate a garden for all seasons and tackle a bunch of seasonal jobs for September.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: A catch-up with three sisters in Dorset to discover how their collapsed greenhouse turned into an opportunity to transform part of their garden. Plus, Monty plants garlic and onions, transplants foxgloves, and prepares his strawberry bed for winter.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: Although she has an excellent job at the Metropolitan Museum of Art and a fabulous apartment with model roommates, New Yorker Amanda Pierce remains unlucky in love and intent on finding the right guy. When she develops a crush on neighbor Jim Winston, she begins to spy on him and witnesses his apparent involvement in a murder. Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened — and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.desc: When a vicious motorcycle gang launches an assault on a small town and a local girl (Elizabeth James), Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) goes on a one-man crusade to save the town and the girl! The first of the wildly successful Billy Jack feature films.

programme.title: The Glory Stompers
programme.desc: When the leader of the Glory Stompers is brutally attacked by a psychotic rival biker gang that kidnaps his girl and leaves him for dead, he gathers a few buddies and sets out to settle the score! Starring Dennis Hopper, Jody McCrea and Casey Kasem.

programme.title: The Wild Angels
programme.desc: When a biker gang cyclist is injured and hospitalized, he is kidnapped from the hospital but dies. A funeral is staged in the local church with a drunken, drugged-out orgy.

programme.title: Harley Davidson And The Marlboro Man
programme.desc: Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson star in this genre collision of biker, heist, buddy flick and sci-fi pic!

programme.title: Code Of Silence
programme.desc: Chuck Norris stars in this turbo-charged thriller that pits an honest cop against two crime lords and his own department. Henry Silva and Dennis Farina also star in a film that explodes with heart-stopping chases and martial arts confrontations.

programme.title: The Delta Force
programme.desc: Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage...and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

programme.title: Delta Force 2: The Colombian Connection
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is in peak form in this explosive action/adventure that brings back one of his most unforgettable characters, Delta Force Colonel Scott McCoy, for a daring mission to destroy a deadly drug cartel led by the ruthless Billy Drago!

programme.title: American Ninja
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

programme.title: American Ninja 2: The Confrontation
programme.desc: In this action-packed sequel, Joe Armstrong and Curtis Jackson are sent to the Caribbean in search of missing Marines. But they must first battle scientifically engineered Super Ninjas to bring down a dreaded drug lord known as The Lion!

programme.title: American Ninja 3: Blood Hunt
programme.desc: Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular "American Ninja" franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

programme.title: American Ninja 4: The Annihilation
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff is back in action in this thrilling sequel! Teamed up with CIA operative Sean Davidson (David Bradley), Joe Armstrong (Dudikoff) returns to help foil the plans of a terrorist (James Booth) hell-bent on annihilating New York City.

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents' brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

programme.title: RoboCop (2014)
programme.desc: When Alex Murphy is critically injured, OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.

programme.title: Return Of Sabata
programme.desc: The great Lee Van Cleef ("Death Rides a Horse") returns as the famous freewheeling gunslinger Sabata. In this third and final go-round for the enigmatic sharpshooter, Sabata seeks revenge when a band of desperadoes bilks him out of $5,000.

programme.title: Man Of The East
programme.desc: East Meets West in this charming spaghetti western in which three petty crooks try to transform an East Coast dandy into a real Wild West man! Starring Terrence Hill, Gregory Walcott, Harry Carey Jr. and Dominic Barto and directed by Enzo Barboni!

programme.title: The Hills Run Red
programme.desc: A man recently released from a five-year prison sentence seeks vengeance against the former friend who has violated his trust and sought his death. Starring Thomas Hunter, Henry Silva, and Dan Duryea.

programme.title: Support Your Local Sheriff!
programme.desc: James Garner stars in this rollicking western spoof that has him taking on the job of a frontier town sheriff who must fend off villains (led by Walter Brennen) from every direction...all without breaking a sweat or dirtying his shiny black boots!

programme.title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
programme.desc: James Garner is back in the saddle again as hustler Latigo Smith whose latest con is passing off cowhand Jug (Jack Elam) as the dreaded gunman Swifty Morgan. But when the real Swifty shows up, the Wild West is going to get a whole lot wackier!

programme.title: Duel At Diablo
programme.desc: Frontier scout Jess Remsberg leads a wagon train through hostile territory to Fort Conchos. But underneath his valor, he has an ulterior motive: to settle a score with the man he believes killed his wife. James Garner and Sidney Poitier star.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: Sharpshooter Matthew Quigley (Tom Selleck) thinks he's been hired to kill wild dogs in Australia. But a wealthy cattle baron (Alan Rickman) has far more nefarious plans for the sharpshooter. Laura San Giacomo also stars in this stylish western.

programme.title: Dances With Wolves
programme.desc: Kevin Costner, Mary McDonnell and Graham Greene star is this masterpiece that took home 7 Academy Awards, including Best Picture. Sent to protect a U.S. outpost, Lt. John Dunbar (Costner) befriends those he was taught to fear, the Sioux Nation.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: Mario Van Peebles and Billy Zane shake up the frontier in this gun-blazing, fist-pounding western that takes a page missing from the history books and unfolds it with suspense, humor and awe-inspiring power! Pam Grier and Isaac Hayes co-star.

programme.title: Hour Of The Gun
programme.desc: Director John Sturges presents a reworking of the Wyatt Earp/Doc Holliday legend and the struggle for political control of Tombstone, with a marvelous trio of antagonists: James Garner as Earp, Jason Robards as Holliday, and Robert Ryan as Clanton.

programme.title: Red River
programme.desc: John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

programme.title: Terror In A Texas Town
programme.desc: In this compelling and imaginative western, a peace-loving Swedish seaman is forced to take on an entire frontier town when he discovers a ruthless oil prospector has been forcing farmers to sell their land...or pay for it with their lives.

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

programme.title: Day Of The Outlaw
programme.desc: In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.

programme.title: Along Came Jones
programme.desc: Gary Cooper gives a marvelous, tongue-in-cheek performance as a fumble-fingered cowpoke who is mistaken for a notorious bandit and almost gets killed by both sides of the law...all while managing to capture the attention of Loretta Young.

programme.title: Man Of The West

programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano trabajan de cuidadores en una casa de retiro para adultos mayores, un anciano muere y ellos creen ser los responsables por lo que se las ingenian para que el muerto parezca vivo y pueda asistir a una fiesta.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano consiguen trabajo en una empresa de mudanzas, pero cargar objetos pesados y cuidar pertenencias ajenas no parece lo más indicado para los chicos.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: Albertano trabaja como maestro de yoga e inicia un romance con una atractiva y adinerada mujer madura, quien lo utiliza para vengarse de su esposo infiel.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano parecen haber encontrado el amor por primera vez al conseguir novias, pero esos romances podrían terminar con su amistad para siempre.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: La amiga de Silvita se queda en el departamento de los recién casados, ya que se ha quedado sin casa. Además, Magda trata de convencer a los vecinos para que acepten poner un anuncio en la fachada del edificio.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Los Rivers solo tienen dinero para comer atún. Así que Frankie envía a Benito a hacer el casting para interpretar al Sol. Pero Luis propone realizar un nuevo reglamento de convivencia vecinal.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Jorjáis cuenta su verdadera historia, y hará llorar a más de uno. Mientras tanto, como Frankie y Lorena no están en casa, Benito y Liz aprovecharán para hacer algo en su ausencia.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Jorge deja su sillón en la entrada del edificio de los vecinos, pero en un momento de descuido, desaparece. Lorena abre una cocina económica.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Los Rivers abren la correspondencia de los López Pérez y se enteran de que les embargarán la lavadora. Silvita y Luis jugarán con Cris y Pedro, para saber quiénes son una pareja real.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Federica convence a Ludovico de que le contrate una sirvienta. Federica se quiere contratar a una mujer conservadora y gruñona, mientras que Ludovico pretende quedarse con una mujer de buen cuerpo aunque algo torpe.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Ludovico y Federica descubren que Martina y Fabio tienen una fiesta y se ofenden por no haberlos invitado. Federica y Ludovico interrumpen la cena de Martina y Fabio con sus nuevos amigos.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Al morir, don Severino, tío de Ludovico, deja escrita una última voluntad: que su sobrino conviva con sus cenizas por dos días a cambio de heredarle toda su fortuna.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Reciben a un primo que no recordaban, y se muere por un pedazo de comida atorado. El primo les hereda todo a la Familia Peluche y pasan por muchas aventuras.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Una jovencita es golpeada por su padre, y para proteger a su madre, no se queja de nada. La mamá de la niña se la pasa tomando pastillas para dormir y descuida a su hija. La maestra se da cuenta de que es maltratada por sus padres.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Una mujer se casa con un hombre muy celoso, con el paso del tiempo se entera de que su exmujer se suicidó por culpa de la enfermedad de su marido y pide ayuda para escapar.
programme.sub-title: Aunque la Jaula sea de Oro

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Un señor sufre un accidente en una construcción. Un joven que trabaja en la construcción queda impactado con el accidente de uno de sus compañeros. La hermana del joven sufre de bullying por ser indígena.
programme.sub-title: No tiene la Culpa el Indio

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Una joven se embaraza del novio de su mejor amiga, la chica oculta la identidad del padre de su hijo. Durante su embarazo la chica les dice a sus amigas que no quiere a su hijo y desea que el bebé nazca sin vida.
programme.sub-title: El Que Esté Libre de Pecado

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Liz se embaraza de Saúl, su novio, pero no quiere hacerse responsable. Liz tiene un padre autoritario al cual no le tiene confianza, pero sin querer, se entera de que su hija está embarazada. Él les obliga a casarse, pero todo es un fracaso.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Una joven que es muy celosa golpea a una chica y le prohíbe hablarle a su novio. Un día la chica y su novio terminan y él le confiesa que está enamorado de otra chica. La joven le pide al chico que vaya a su casa y lo secuestra.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Una joven vive con su abuela, pero la señora la trata muy mal porque ella es hija de la sirvienta. El hijo de la señora pierde su casa en un juego y le pide a su madre que deje que él y su familia vivan con ella.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Un joven regresa a su pueblo y se entera de que su padre ha muerto. El chico amenaza a un hombre cuando descubre que quiere abusar de su novia. El hombre mata a la madre del chico para quedarse con sus tierras.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Un sacerdote se quita su hábito porque tiene mucho calor, un joven le ofrece bolearle los zapatos, pero es una trampa para asaltarlo, lo golpea y se desmaya. El sacerdote se despierta y no recuerda nada.
programme.sub-title: El Hombre es Fuego, La Mujer Estopa
